title: Oxbow Retail — returns chatbot integration (call notes)
content:
Meeting: Oxbow Retail tech sync — Feb 14 2025 10:00 PST
Attendees: Maya Chen (Redwood), Jamal Ortiz (Redwood SE), Priya Raman (Oxbow PM), Evan Park (Oxbow infra), Sarah Li (Oxbow ops)
Purpose: quick scoping call to capture requirements, immediate blockers, and low-risk rollout plan for returns chatbot (customer-facing).

High-level ask from Oxbow:
- Customer-facing chat UI to handle returns flow (lookup order, validate reason, generate RMA, recommend alternative items)
- Support image attachments (photo of damaged item) for triage
- PII controls: order numbers, customer emails are considered sensitive — they want redaction / tokenization pipeline or Private deployment
- Latency target: 95th percentile < 600ms for text-only, < 1.2s when invoking vision pipeline
- Cost sensitivity: aiming to keep avg cost-per-session under $0.20 initially

Notes / observations from call (raw):
- Oxbow currently has a service that returns order JSON via internal API (auth via SSO). Evan: "we can proxy, but need SAML handshake in private network"
- They prefer a Private deployment in EU region due to data residency and retailer contracts (legal signoff required)
- They want deterministic fallback: when high load, serve shorter prompts to a smaller quantized model (we discussed Redwood routing + model variants)
- Vision step: they will preprocess images into short captions on their side (initial plan) to avoid heavy multimodal inference; long-term want Redwood-vision hook
- Concern: product catalog embedding drift — they update catalog 2x/day. Need embedding refresh policy + cache invalidation TTL

Technical gotchas called out:
- Tokenization mismatch: their order descriptions include emojis + non-ascii product SKUs that blow token counts. Need token budget guardrails and prompt sanitizer
- Session affinity: returns flow needs session KV cache (KV cache across model rollouts). Discussed using Redis + Redwood prefix caching. Evan worried about network hop latency
- Privacy: logs retention policy — Oxbow wants PII removed before any logs leave their VPC. Private control plane + customer-side redaction recommended.
- Attachment size: photos > 3MB should be rejected upstream; we need clear spec for image size/resolution and thumbnailing policy

Immediate requirements (MVP):
1) Text-only path that integrates with internal order API and can generate RMA emails (structured fields: order_id, items, return_reason, return_label_url)
2) Embedding lookup for related items (catalog embed index hosted by Oxbow initially)
3) Private deployment in eu-west-1 with KMS integration and log retention window configurable
4) Simple prompt templates (1-2 variants) + set of 20 test prompts from Oxbow for quality gating

Proposed rollout plan (fastlane):
- Week 0 (this week): exchange API contract + sample order JSON (Priya to share by Feb 17).
- Week 1: Redwood SE builds POC connector + sample convo flow on hosted sandbox (no PII) -> demo to Oxbow on Feb 24.
- Week 2-3: Private deploy trial in eu-west-1, integrate SSO proxy and KMS, run soak test with synthetic traffic.
- Week 4: Add image captioning passthrough & small vision sanity checks.
- Metrics to validate: 95p latency, avg token cost, end-to-end RMA success rate, false-positive fraud rejects

Open questions / blockers (needs followup):
- Legal: will Oxbow accept "transient logs" on hosted plane or insist on on-prem-only? (Priya to confirm w/ legal by Feb 19)
- Catalog embeddings: who will host index? Oxbow prefers to host but wants Redwood guidance on vector format and upsert cadence
- SSO details: Evan needs SSH access window + SAML metadata exchange — set up ticket ENG-2847
- QA prompts: Oxbow to provide at least 20 annotated examples (happy / unhappy path) for regression checks

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Priya: share sample order JSON + current catalog export (CSV) by 2025-02-17 (owner: Priya)
- Jamal: prototype prompt templates + low-cost model variant configuration; PR to repo by 2025-02-21 (owner: Jamal)
- Evan: send SAML metadata and network CIDR restrictions for private deploy by 2025-02-18 (owner: Evan)
- Maya: draft initial architecture sketch + security checklist in Confluence page and link into SE-112 by 2025-02-19 (owner: Maya)
- All: sync on Slack channel #oxbow-integration for day-to-day questions (setup by Maya)

Risk notes (unsafe assumptions we flagged):
- Assuming Oxbow can sanitize images client-side — if they cannot, we need to add a vision-moderation preprocessing step which affects latency/cost
- Assuming catalog updates are small (they're ~5k SKUs/day) — if catalog is larger, embedding hosting + nearest-neighbor latency will change design

Testing & Eval plan (short):
- Use 20 annotated prompts for quality/regression; run A/B on model variant vs quantized variant for latency/cost tradeoffs
- Create a small gold dataset for RMA parsing (50 examples) to validate structured extraction 95%+

Notes-to-self / internal reminders (rough):
- Check Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + cache TTL for small sessions (might save 30% cost)
- Bring up KV cache affinity options with infra team — Evan's latency sensitivity may push to co-locate redis in customer VPC
- Add a short-blurb in demo about graceful degradation (fallback model + human handoff) — customers like visible safety nets

Next sync: Wed Feb 26 (tentative) — aim to have sample artifacts and POC link ready.

---
Raw scratchy thoughts / brainstorm (do not present):
- Could we offer a hybrid: embedding index hosted by Redwood but encrypted with Oxbow key? simpler ops for them but meets legal sometimes
- If image captioning lives client-side, provide tiny JS lib (open-source) to standardize captions -> ask growth/oss team

End of notes.
